image_description: A silver-toned metal chain necklace draped in a U-shape (catenary) against a plain, light beige background. The chain consists of faceted, bead-like links rather than simple oval rings, interspersed with small charms including a blue figure and a circular pendant. There is visible text watermark 'wh123.com' on the left side.
